# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_008_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 8

**8:1** And her parents went down marveling and praising and glorifying the Lord God because the child did not turn back. And Mary was in the temple of the Lord as a dove that is nurtured, and she received food from the hand of an angel.

**8:2** And when she was twelve years old there was held a council of the priests, saying, "Behold, Mary has become twelve years old in the temple of the Lord our God. What then shall we do with her, that she may not defile the sanctuary of the Lord our God?"

**8:3** And they said to the high priest, "You stand at the altar of the Lord; go in and pray concerning her, and whatever the Lord God reveals to you, this we will do."

**8:4** And the high priest took the vestment with twelve bells and went into the Holy of Holies and prayed concerning her. And behold, an angel of the Lord appeared and said to him, "Zechariah, Zechariah, go out and assemble the widowers of the people, and let them bring each one a staff, and to whomsoever the Lord God shows a sign, his wife she shall be."

**8:5** And the heralds went out through all the surrounding country of Judea, and the trumpet of the Lord sounded, and all came running together.
